title: Finite-projective Hom is tensor with the explicit dual
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, with module sheaves on the bottom-topology one-object ringed site [def-pc-perfect-rhom-base-change-map]. Let P,Q be cochain complexes. Assume there are integers a,b such that P^n vanishes whenever n<a or b<n, and every evaluated term P^n is finite projective. Put D=Hom_A^\bullet(P,A[0]), the explicit dual construction of [lem-pc-perfect-ring-dual-term-flat]. Then there exists a chain isomorphism Tot(D\otimes_A Q)\cong Hom_A^\bullet(P,Q), for the shared total tensor [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] and Hom [def-pur-hom-complex]. No boundedness or K-flatness of Q is assumed.

source.place: Tag 0A6A, lemma-base-change-RHom, clause (1), expanded chain-level evaluation; Tag 0ATK, lemma-base-change-evaluation-map, clause (1)

proof.text: For each integer n use the normalized degreewise evaluation isomorphism. These are isomorphisms of sheaf modules only, with no differential compatibility included. Choose the family of isomorphisms and retain its signed evaluation condition.
Apply the differential compatibility theorem to the homs of the chosen family, with their retained signed evaluation formulas. No boundedness or invertibility is needed for this step.

Assemble the degreewise isomorphisms and their differential identity using Mathlib HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoOfComponents. Its inverse chain-map identities follow by cancellation with the component inverses, and its two chain-map inverse identities hold componentwise. Wrap this chain isomorphism in Nonempty.

lean.statement: theorem perfectRingHom_tensorDual_iso {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (P Q : CochainComplex (RingSiteModules A) ℤ) (hb : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (P.X n)) (hp : ∀ n : ℤ, Module.Projective A ((P.X n).val.obj (op ⟨PUnit.unit⟩))) (hf : ∀ n : ℤ, Module.Finite A ((P.X n).val.obj (op ⟨PUnit.unit⟩))) : letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory (CochainComplex.onePointRingSheaf A) Nonempty (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor (perfectRingDual P) Q (curriedTensor _) ≅ homComplex (R := CochainComplex.onePointRingSheaf A) P Q)
